recent_articles.title: Rubio's maiden India visit aims to repair strained ties; boost Quad cooperation - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio** will visit **India** from May 23 to 26, 2026, aiming to repair strained bilateral ties.  He will meet with **External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar**, **Prime Minister Narendra Modi**, and attend a Quad Foreign Ministers meeting in New Delhi. The trip follows a recent three-day visit by **India's Foreign Secretary Vikram Misri** to Washington DC focused on stabilizing the relationship.  The talks are expected to focus on bolstering ties in energy, trade, investment, critical technology, and people-to-people exchanges, as well as discussing the West Asia crisis and its economic impact.

recent_articles.title: Picked wrong Melody? Parle Industries shares hit 5% upper circuit for 3rd day - The Economic Times
recent_articles.rephrased_article: During a visit to Italy, **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** gifted **Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni** a bag of candies called "Melody." The viral video of the exchange sparked interest in Indian brands and led to marketing campaigns by companies like **Air India**.  The candy's maker, **Parle Products**, confirmed it is exported to 100 countries. While Parle Industries shares saw a significant jump following the incident, the company has no immediate plans for an initial public offering.

recent_articles.title: Voter confusion fears over simultaneous polls ‘misplaced’, says ONOE JPC chairman - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **P.P. Chaudhary**, chairman of the Joint Parliamentary Committee on ‘One Nation One Election’, defended the proposal, arguing that Indian voters are politically astute and can differentiate between national and state issues.  He cited examples from Delhi and other states where voters supported different parties in Lok Sabha and Assembly elections. **CII**, **ASSOCHAM**, and **GCCI** backed the proposal, while **Gujarat University Vice-Chancellor Dr. Neerja Gupta** highlighted how frequent polls disrupt academic schedules and increase financial costs. The committee also heard concerns from the **Congress**, which argued that simultaneous elections would allow national narratives to overshadow state issues.

recent_articles.title: Gujarat Police trace 701 missing persons under ‘Operation Milap’ in two weeks - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Gujarat Police** have successfully reunited 701 missing persons with their families through a statewide operation called **Operation Milap**, which ran from May 7 to May 21.  The initiative, aimed at reviewing pending missing person cases, involved analyzing old records and conducting fresh field verifications. The drive also included checking digital records, social media activity, transport locations, and shelter homes, with officials noting some cases were linked to trafficking networks. **Deputy Chief Minister Harsh Sanghavi** stated the government provided resources for the operation.

recent_articles.title: Ladakh leaders to meet Home Ministry officials on May 22, Sonam Wangchuk part of delegation - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A delegation from Ladakh, including climate activist **Sonam Wangchuk**, is meeting with **Union Home Ministry** officials on Friday to discuss demands for constitutional safeguards such as Statehood and inclusion under the Sixth Schedule of the Constitution. This meeting follows a previous inconclusive high-powered committee meeting in February and comes after the violence in Leh city in September 2025, which stalled talks.  The delegation will reiterate their demands for Statehood, while officials have offered safeguards under Article 371 of the Constitution.

recent_articles.title: Take forward reforms, PM tells Ministers - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** convened a full Council of Ministers meeting in New Delhi on Thursday, May 21, 2026. The session focused on the government's reform agenda amidst geopolitical shifts and saw presentations from various ministries including labor, power, commerce, finance, agriculture, railways, and NITI Aayog.  The meetings reviewed past achievements and future plans, outlining targets for each ministry.

recent_articles.title: Bihar midday meal incident: HC asks whether NGO can continue providing meals - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Patna High Court** has expressed concern over delays in the investigation of a midday meal incident where over 150 students fell ill in Saharsa district. The court questioned whether the NGO supplying meals to over 1,800 students should continue operations during the probe and raised concerns about discrepancies in food sample collection and testing.  The court directed officials to file affidavits explaining the processes involved. The matter will be heard again on June 2nd.

recent_articles.title: Parle Industries hits upper circuit amid ‘Melody’ confusion - The Economic Times
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Parle Industries** shares surged 5% on Wednesday after a social media video showed **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** giving a 'Melody' toffee to his Italian counterpart, **Giorgia Meloni**. The stock's trading volume spiked significantly, exceeding its two-week average. This is not an isolated incident; similar mix-ups have occurred in the past with companies like LG Electronics India and Tata Motors, highlighting the potential for confusion among retail investors during market volatility.

recent_articles.title: PM busy handing out candies in Italy amid economic storm at home, says Congress - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Congress** president Mallikarjun Kharge and **Rahul Gandhi** criticized the **Narendra Modi** government's economic policies, accusing it of prioritizing publicity over addressing rising inflation, unemployment, and weakening economic indicators.  **Kharge** highlighted the increase in average debt per Indian and wealth concentration among billionaires, while **Gandhi** criticized the Prime Minister's focus on foreign trips during a time of economic distress. Congress officials also pointed to the rupee's decline, falling foreign exchange reserves, and large investor outflows as evidence of government mismanagement.

recent_articles.title: No double standards, we condemn Russia, U.S. and Israel for international law violations: Norway’s Foreign Minister - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Espen Barth Eide**, **Norwegian Foreign Minister**, urged **India** and **Norway** to increase their engagement to avoid becoming overly reliant on any single global power.  He highlighted the potential for increased trade, technology transfer, and renewable energy cooperation as key areas of focus. While Norway prefers India reduce its reliance on Russian oil, it acknowledges India's concerns regarding energy security.

recent_articles.title: Modi, Shah are traitors who are attacking the Constitution, says Rahul at Rae Bareli meet - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Rahul Gandhi**, leader of the **Congress** party, criticized **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** and **Union Home Minister Amit Shah**, accusing them of attacking the Constitution and supporting industrialists. He also warned of an impending economic crisis, stating that it would disproportionately affect ordinary citizens while benefiting those in power.  Gandhi unveiled a statue of Veera Pasi in Rae Bareli, highlighting his party's renewed focus on the community. He further criticized the BJP government over land acquisition policies and unemployment rates, vowing to fight for the rights of the people.

recent_articles.title: Average of 53% MPs attend meetings of 16 Parliamentary Standing Committees, PAC: data - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** has been raising concerns about the low attendance of members at parliamentary committees.  Data shows that an average of 53% of members attended meetings of 16 department-related Standing Committees and the Public Accounts Committee since their reconstitution last September, with five meetings postponed due to a lack of quorum. The data also reveals that nearly 47% of members were absent from these meetings, with better attendance observed in committees focused on Railways, Petroleum and Natural Gas, External Affairs, and Finance.  The Standing Committees discussed various important subjects including India-Sri Lanka relations, the review of the working of Border Roads Organisation (BRO), research and technology development in renewable energy, and safety and security of the diaspora during the ongoing conflict in West Asia.

recent_articles.title: NEET paper leak row: Congress demands resignation of Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Congress** leaders demanded the resignation of **Dharmendra Pradhan**, the **Union Education Minister**, over the NEET-UG paper leak scandal.  They accused the government of a "money-making racket" involving people linked to the ruling establishment and claimed that the incident had caused immense trauma for 22 lakh students. **Rahul Gandhi** called for the Prime Minister's intervention, while **Mallikarjun Kharge**, the Congress president, alleged that the Modi government was undermining student credibility through repeated paper leaks.  **Jairam Ramesh**, a Congress general secretary, criticized the government's lack of action and incompetence in addressing exam reforms.

recent_articles.title: Remove Bandi Sanjay from Union Cabinet, Kavitha tells Modi - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Kalvakuntla Kavitha**, president of the **Telangana Rakshana Sena**, urged **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** to remove **Union Minister of State for Home Affairs Bandi Sanjay Kumar** from his position until the investigation and trial in the POCSO case involving his son are complete.  Kavitha expressed concern over potential conflict of interest and a perception of political influence on the investigation, arguing that public trust in the justice system could be damaged by Mr. Kumar's continued presence in office.

recent_articles.title: Push for public transport exposes structural gaps - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Prime Minister Narendra Modi's** push for public transport, particularly metro rail, has prompted politicians and bureaucrats to use such systems. However, the renewed spotlight on public transit highlights a gap between policy intent and on-ground delivery.  Years of underinvestment in mass rapid transit systems have led to stalled projects like the Hyderabad Metro’s second phase and the Multi-Modal Transport System (MMTS) network. While efforts are underway to improve connectivity and funding, challenges remain, including securing approvals for expansion and procuring new train sets. The State government is also exploring a Rapid Rail Transit System (RRTS), but its suitability for urban settings remains questioned.

recent_articles.title: BRICS is evolving with new members; differences will take time to resolve: Brazil FM Mauro Vieira - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **BRICS** Foreign Ministers meeting in Delhi concluded with a detailed Chair Statement supporting Indian initiatives and the Palestinian cause, but failed to reach consensus on positions regarding the war in West Asia.  Despite disagreements, **Mauro Vieira**, Brazilian Foreign Minister, emphasized the continued importance of **BRICS**.

recent_articles.title: PM Modi arrives in Netherlands on second leg of five-nation tour - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** arrived in the Netherlands on Friday, May 15, 2026, for a two-day visit to further strengthen bilateral cooperation. **Modi** met with **Dutch counterpart Rob Jetten**, and will also meet with King Willem-Alexander and Queen Maxima. The visit is part of a five-nation tour that includes stops in Sweden, Norway, and Italy.  The trip comes as the India-EU Free Trade Agreement has been finalized, and the India-EFTA Trade and Economic Partnership Agreement was signed in 2025.

recent_articles.title: PM Modi in Netherlands LIVE: Prime Minister lauds Dutch coach’s role in Indian women’s hockey success - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** arrived in the Netherlands on Friday, May 15, 2026, for a two-day visit to further strengthen bilateral ties. **Mr. Modi** met with his Dutch counterpart, **Rob Jetten**, and was welcomed by senior officials from both countries, including **Rear Admiral Ludger Brummelaar**. The visit marks an important juncture in the India-Netherlands relationship, which has expanded beyond traditional sectors into areas like technology, defense, and renewable energy.
